findings.highlight: "Not in particular. I have been satisfied with each meal you have prepared thus far."
findings.evidenceJa: 「私は特に。シロウが用意してくれる食事なら、概ね満足しています」
findings.governingReading: Saber says she is generally or for the most part satisfied with meals Shirou prepares.
findings.explanation: Qualified general satisfaction becomes satisfaction with every meal.

findings.evidenceJa: 「はい。期待しています、シロウ」
findings.governingReading: Saber says she is looking forward to what Shirou will prepare.
findings.explanation: Anticipating Shirou’s cooking becomes merely waiting for him.

findings.highlight: They'll be piping hot balls of ground shrimp, a bit bigger than takoyaki.
findings.evidenceJa: たこ焼きを一回りほど大きくした、中身がほくほくでエビがあつあつの一品だ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou plans dumplings larger than takoyaki, with a fluffy or steaming interior and piping-hot shrimp.
findings.explanation: The shrimp-ball description loses its fluffy interior and invents ground shrimp.
